name: Venomancer: Ritualistic refunds 20% of base mana on each Green Salve cast (#9349)
contract: #9349: Ritualistic 503918 reads 'Casting Green Salve now also refunds you $504797s1% of your base mana.'; 504797 effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESTORE_BASE_MANA_PCT with BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = 20. Green Salve rank 4 502976 (BaseLevel 28) costs ManaCostPercentage 15 of base mana. ascension_class_stats class 29 level 28 BaseMana is 707, so the cast costs int(707*15/100) = 106 and the refund is uint(707*20/100) = 141, logged through the Energize Base 5% helper 681318; the net mana change of one cast is +35. The baseline in the same run (Ritualistic unlearned) must pay 106 and log no refund. Regeneration is suppressed so power deltas are exact.
